column1: # Authored expectation for the Phase-5 test-surface join.
# Section S clause 2: the run enumerates its test surfaces and joins them completely to an
# independently authored expectation. The join is two-way and total, so a check that
# exists but is claimed by no surface fails the gate, and a surface naming an id nothing
# owner is the registry the ids are enumerated from at run time:
#   checks    the check ids tools/lift_calculus_gate.py implements
# `no-fallback-arm` has a surface of its own because it is a claim about the source rather
# than about any value the source computes: a dispatch that answers every pair correctly
# today and carries a catch-all is still the thing a fourth layer would fall into. No
# table can see that, so the scan is its own instrument and its own row.
# The last two surfaces are the ones this register cannot reach. Whether teardown is an
# obligation the type system tracks is the workflow calculus's claim, which is the next
# phase's; and nothing here observes a running system, so no frame is entered and no
# engine answers. Both carry a metric whose recorded value is the literal UNVERIFIED.
